autoRouter.heading: Auto routers
autoRouter.description: Auto routers sit above your deployments and pick a model per request. They are called like any other model, so clients keep using a single model name.
autoRouter.addDescription: Routes each request to a model by classifying its complexity. Called like any other model, so clients keep using a single model name.

accessGroupBudget.adminOnly: Only a proxy admin can change an access group budget
accessGroupBudget.slashBlocked: A budget cannot be set on a group whose name contains a slash
accessGroupBudget.nothingToClear: This access group has no budget to clear

empty.title: No model access groups yet
empty.hint: Put a deployment in an access group from its model settings, then give the group a shared budget here.

accessGroupBudget.description: A model access group can carry one budget that every key granted the group by name draws from together. Keys that reach the group's models through a wildcard or all-proxy-models are not charged against it.
accessGroupBudget.clearMessage: Are you sure you want to clear this access group's budget? The recorded shared spend is cleared with it, and the group's models stay available.

form.validation: Set at least one of max budget, soft budget or reset window
form.description: Every key granted this access group by name draws from this one budget. A key that reaches the group's models through a wildcard or all-proxy-models is not charged against it.
form.maxBudgetHint: Total the whole group may spend. Once its shared spend reaches this, every key that draws from the group is refused
form.softBudgetHint: Fires an alert when the group's spend reaches this. Requests keep succeeding
form.resetBudgetHint: How often the group's spend resets. Leave empty for a budget that never resets
form.blankHint: A field left blank keeps whatever the budget already has. Use Clear budget to remove the budget itself.

retry.globalDescription: Default retry settings applied to all model groups unless overridden
retry.groupDescription: Model-specific retry settings. Falls back to global defaults if not set.
